_comment: Validation-tier wave list. `waves` is the list's LENGTH and each wave's all-regular count; `parts` REPLACES what a named wave is made of, exactly as `.keys`'s `compose` verb does (waves.loft § WaveFile). A wave with no part is its count in regulars. Class names come from passable.loft::enemy_class_of — an unknown one is refused, never defaulted. Spawn marker selection per enemy is random across the markers placed on the map; their direction governs the approach heading.
